# Serious Studios

> Creative design agency specialising in brand identity, packaging, art direction, and digital design.

Serious Studios is a creative design studio that works with brands at inflection points — launches, rebrands, pivots, and moments when visual identity needs to catch up to ambition. The studio delivers brand identity systems, packaging design, art direction, and digital design for ambitious brands across fashion, hospitality, technology, retail, and FMCG.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://malfad.github.io/serious-studios/): Portfolio overview and studio introduction
- [Work](https://malfad.github.io/serious-studios/work/): Full portfolio of 60+ completed projects with category filters
- [Journal](https://malfad.github.io/serious-studios/blog/): Weekly articles on design thinking, process, and craft
- [About](https://malfad.github.io/serious-studios/about/): Studio background, methodology, and FAQ
- [Contact](https://malfad.github.io/serious-studios/contact/): Project enquiries

## Services

- **Brand Identity Design** — logomarks, wordmarks, visual identity systems
- **Brand Systems** — comprehensive design systems with tokens, guidelines, and governance
- **Art Direction** — creative direction for campaigns, photography, and editorial
- **Packaging Design** — shelf-ready packaging with retail impact
- **Digital Design** — UI/UX, web design, and digital brand expression

## Team / Authors

- **Meela** — Senior Designer, specialises in brand identity, colour systems, and packaging
- **Manuel** — Design Director, leads brand strategy, typography, and identity work
- **Aqui** — Designer, focuses on packaging, cross-cultural design, and spatial branding

## Methodology

Three-phase process: Discovery → Design → Delivery. Projects typically run 6 weeks for a full brand identity sprint.

## Journal topics covered

Brand identity, typography, packaging design, design process, layout and grid, brand strategy, luxury branding, hospitality design, motion design, cross-cultural design, retail design, design systems.
